title: The derived tensor unit is compact on a qcqs scheme
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme]. There is an object U in D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] isomorphic in D(O_X) to the unit of the fixed derived tensor structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and U is compact [def-pc-compact-object]. Coproducts are those of [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums].

source.place: Proposition perfect-proposition-compact-is-perfect (Tag 09M1), proof, first paragraph; structure-sheaf case

proof.text: The fixed K-flat derived tensor unit [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] is isomorphic to the structure sheaf in degree zero: the underived structure sheaf is flat and the monoidal localization takes its degree-zero complex to its unit. Its only nonzero cohomology is the quasi-coherent structure sheaf, so it gives an object U of D_QCoh.

source.place: Proposition perfect-proposition-compact-is-perfect (Tag 09M1), proof, first paragraph; structure-sheaf case

proof.text: Take the structure morphism a:X to Spec(Z), using ULift(Z) to stay in the scheme universe. It is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. The structure sheaf is flat, so derived pullback of O_Spec(Z) is O_X. Apply [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint] to obtain Hom(O_X,N) = Hom(O_Spec(Z),Ra_*N), additively and naturally in N.

source.place: Proposition perfect-proposition-compact-is-perfect (Tag 09M1), proof, first paragraph; structure-sheaf case

proof.text: Derived direct image commutes with coproducts of quasi-coherent objects by [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-direct-sums]. By [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] on Spec(Z), Hom(O_Spec(Z),L) is H^0(RGamma(L)). That equivalence preserves coproducts. Coproducts of complexes of Z-modules are termwise and exact; hence their H^0 is the direct sum of the H^0 groups. The ambient and full-subcategory coproducts agree by [lem-pc-derived-ambient-direct-sums] and [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums]. Naturality identifies this bijection on each summand with composition by its inclusion, so the canonical map in [def-pc-compact-object] is bijective, including for the empty family.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_compact_derivedTensorUnit (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] :
    letI : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) := derivedQCohDirectSums X
    ∃ U : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      Nonempty (U.obj ≅ 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X)) ∧ IsCompactObject U
